---
title: "Animations"
description-meta: "Interactive pictures of supersingular isogeny graphs: random walks, growing balls, and the spectral law of Hecke operators."
---

The supersingular isogeny graphs $G_p(2)$, $G_p(\{2,3\})$ and $G_p(\{2,3,5\})$ for 221 primes from 101 to 49991, and graphs with level structure $\Gamma_0(5)$, $\Gamma_1(5)$, $\Gamma(2)$ and $\Gamma(4)$. Each can be shown in full, as its $\mathbb{F}_p$-subgraph, or as its quotient by Frobenius.

[Random walks](walks.qmd)
: The Petersson walk on the full graphs; the simple random walk on the other views.

[Blooming](balls.qmd)
: Balls grown until they close a cycle, or until they contain a Frobenius-conjugate pair.

[Spectral law](spectral.qmd)
: The eigenvalues of $T_\ell$ on $S_2(\Gamma_0(p))$ against the Kesten–McKay law, and those of $T_2 + T_3$ and $T_2 + T_3 + T_5$ against its convolutions.

[Read more](about.qmd)
: Definitions, proofs and sources.
